entries.purpose: Independent deterministic test-only classic ZIP writer and controlled malformed-record mutations.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile the committed Swift 6 source with Foundation only. Construct ordered ArchiveRecipe.Entry values and call encode() or encodeWithLayout(). Inputs select raw names, payload, type, flags, method, declared sizes/CRC, extra fields, per-member comments and fixed-header patches; offsets support deterministic byte mutations. Temporary recipes supply large/adversarial cases; no large committed assets. Optional prefix and bytesBeforeDirectory insert verbatim boundary-layout bytes while preserving absolute indexed offsets, for self-extracting, gap and hidden-member recipes. Entry.payloadPatches applies deterministic payload-relative mutations only after CRC and size declarations are recorded, allowing content-corruption fixtures with matching local and central metadata. EntryType includes independently declared Unix character-device, block-device, FIFO and socket modes for namespace/type rejection fixtures; raw-name and central-header patches reproduce unsupported encodings and host/type metadata without product code. repeatedUSDALiterals(valueBytes:count:paddingBytes:) authors the original #usda 1.0 LF header, count verbatim single-delimited asset values separated by spaces, then space padding; use temporary bytes for exact/over 16 MiB layers, 4 KiB authored tokens and 100,000-token scanner boundaries. It performs no escaping, so deliberately invalid lexical vectors remain verbatim. Optional tripleDelimited selects @@@ delimiters without altering authored value bytes; raw delimiter escapes remain verbatim for resolver/lexer integration fixtures.

entries.purpose: Original deterministic PNG IHDR and JPEG SOF header vectors, bounded segment padding and controlled malformed-header mutations; header-only JPEG bytes are not valid complete-image or scene oracles.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile committed Swift 6 ImageRecipes.swift with Foundation and ArchiveRecipe.swift. pngHeader(width:height:) writes the PNG signature, 13-byte RGBA 8-bit IHDR with caller-selected big-endian dimensions and independent CRC-32. jpegHeader(marker:width:height:precision:leadingSegments:) writes SOI and one three-component SOF (default SOF0, 16x8, precision 8); SOF1/SOF2 and unsupported marker values are selected explicitly. jpegSegment(marker:fields:) encodes the two-byte inclusive length. jpegPadding(byteCount:) writes exact-sized APP1 segments of at most 65,537 total bytes with 0x42 bodies. Tests truncate every header prefix and mutate signatures, IHDR lengths including 0xffffffff, dimensions, CRC, frame lengths/counts/components and marker framing. Leading padding puts marker/length fields across 64 KiB boundaries and SOF ends at/one byte beyond 1,048,576; un-read trailing 0xab bytes model pixels. These are original header-only vectors, not decoder-validation fixtures; Fixtures.pixelPNG() supplies the original complete PNG.

entries.recipe: Compile the committed Swift 6 TestSupport source with Foundation and Darwin. CLIProcessTests launch only the built usdz-validator selected by the matching suite or harness-only UVK_CLI_EXECUTABLE / UVK_CLI_TEST_EXECUTABLE. Separate temporary stdout/stderr files prevent pipe backpressure; a 15-second deadline terminates and reaps a stuck child. Scripts/test-cli.sh builds a normal release binary and an isolated UVK_PROCESS_TESTING binary. The latter accepts only fixed internalFailure/checkerUnavailable/checkerSuccess/checkerFailure scenarios through a wholly compile-guarded source hook and Validator constructor; fake ProcessResult values exercise the real native engine, adapter orchestration, coverage and gate without any installed checker. Native test archives use the manifest-defined original Fixtures and ArchiveRecipe; the PXR-USDCsynthetic bytes explicitly model incomplete native coverage and are not a conforming-scene oracle. No downloads or arbitrary executable/arguments are accepted by the production CLI.
